Background
1) In partnership with the National Jal Jeevan Mission (NJJM), the Nobel Laureate Prof. Dr. Michael Kremer
and his team, "Evidence Action," have undertaken a structured pilot study to conduct a comprehensive
evaluation of in-line chlorination (ILC) technologies suitable for implementation in both Single Village
Scheme (SVS) and Multi Village Scheme (MVS). The pilot study was carried out in three States i.e.,
Andhra Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, and Rajasthan.
2) The pilot study assessed three categories of devices within the SVS, encompassing
o tablet-based passive in-line chlorination devices (Easol PureALL 100 - recommended by the Standing
Committee of the Department of Drinking Water & Sanitation);
o non-electric liquid chlorine dosing devices (HiSafe Chloritron – recommended by the Technical
Committee of the Department of Drinking Water & Sanitation); and
o electric liquid chlorine dosing pumps (from the market).
3) To disseminate the outcome of the pilot study, a “National Symposium of Safe Water and Disinfection/
Chlorination Initiatives” was held on 02.02.2024 at SPM-NIWAS, Kolkata.
4) All the States/ UTs and Professor Chair from IIT Kanpur & IIT Guwahati were asked to submit a
presentation on Safe Water and Disinfection/ Chlorination Initiatives implementedby them.
5) The Symposium was attended by officials from various States/ UTs, Professor Chair from IIT Kanpur &
IIT Guwahati, academic institutions, private sector players, research organizations, and WASH community
organizations.

# Ashok Reddy Advices Online Water Quality Monitoring, Accurate Tanker Filling Records

Telangana

DC Correspondent

22 Oct 2026 1:10 PM IST22 Oct 2026 1:10 PM IST

## Ashok Reddy examined purified water quality standards and test results at the filling station and instructed officials to register water quality test results online periodically

x

Hyderabad Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board (HMWS&SB) Managing Director K. Ashok Reddy inspecting Kokapet Green Water Filling Station here on Thursday. (Photo: By Arrangement)

As Preferred  
Source

**Hyderabad:** Hyderabad Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board (HMWS&SB) Managing Director K. Ashok Reddy inspected Kokapet Green Water Filling Station here on Thursday.

He examined purified water quality standards and test results at the filling station and instructed officials to register water quality test results online periodically. He suggested setting up filling marks to accurately identify the quantity of water filled in tankers.

He ordered to mandatorily record the quantity of water filled in each tanker and filling details. Reddy asked for continuous monitoring of the quality of purified water and supply quantity and advised to promote the use of purified water for construction sector, road cleanliness, dust control, and gardens.

He asked officials to accord priority to use purified water to reduce pressure on drinking water resources.

( Source : Deccan Chronicle )
